item.title: [Cisco Secure Access] Investigate Dashboard Degradation [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 14:15 and 15:40 UTC, customers using the Investigate dashboard and associated data retrieval APIs may have experienced 503 errors, unavailable graphs or data, and errors when retrieving logs or graph information. The issue has been resolved, and service has returned to normal.

item.title: Cisco Secure Access – Policy Enforcement Traffic Disruption – United Kingdom [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting the Policy Enforcement service for some customers connecting through the London data center has been resolved as of 22:46 UTC on August 24, 2026. Between 22:37 UTC and 22:46 UTC, affected customers may have experienced intermittent traffic disruption through the firewall service. The impacted workload was moved to a healthy infrastructure node, and all services are now operating normally. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience. We’re Here to Help If you have any questions, please contact our support team. Thank you for your understanding as we improve your Cisco Secure Access experience.

item.title: Cisco Secure Access - Traffic Degradation for 6 minutes in US Virginia [resolved]
item.description:
The issue has been resolved.
Customers in US Virginia DC may have experienced traffic degradation due to a service health-check failure that caused traffic handling to move to a healthy node between 9:52 UTC to 9:58 UTC, when the issue got resolved.
No customer action is required.

item.title: [Cisco Secure Access] – Data Classification Accuracy Issue (DSPM) [resolved]
item.description:
Between 12:12 UTC and 13:15 UTC, customers may have experienced default document classification values for some files in the DSPM dashboard. All other DSPM functions remained fully operational throughout this period. The issue affecting document classification within the Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) service is now resolved.
Affected files will be updated automatically as soon as any activity on the file happens. No customer action is required.
We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding.

item.title: Cisco Secure Access - Intermittent Clientless Access and Enterprise Browser issues - US East and Canada [resolved]
item.description:

Affected customers may have experienced intermittent failures when starting new Clientless Access or Enterprise Browser sessions, including some step-up login workflows, in the US East and Canada regions. Some onboarding-related workflows may also have experienced intermittent failures.
Services have returned to normal operation.

item.title: Cisco Secure Access - Intermittent connectivity issues with Firewall and VPN services - India and Tokyo [resolved]
item.description:
We have mitigated the issue affecting Cisco Secure Access Firewall and VPN services in specific India and Tokyo locations.
Affected customers may have experienced intermittent connectivity issues, including packet loss or temporary connection drops, for services associated with the csc_ap-south-1_1_0 location in India and the csc-apne1-1-0-0 location in Tokyo. This issue did not affect all Cisco Secure Access services or all customers in these regions.
Remote Access VPN service has recovered in both affected locations, and services are currently stable. Our teams are continuing to monitor service health and have paused related maintenance activity while the incident is reviewed.
We appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.

item.title: Cisco Secure Access- Traffic Disruption and VPN Connection Impact - US (Miami DCv2) [resolved]

All services are healthy, and the environment is operating normally. We’re Here to Help If you continue to experience issues, please contact Cisco Support.

item.title: Cisco Secure Access - New Organization Creation Delay [resolved]
item.description:
This issue has been resolved.
Certificate issuance for Cisco Secure Access Remote Access VPN provisioning has returned to normal, and the certificate provisioning backlog has cleared. New Remote Access VPN region provisioning and first-time VPN setup workflows should now complete as expected.
Existing VPN regions and active access were not expected to be impacted.
Thank you for your patience. If you continue to experience issues, please contact Cisco Customer Support.

item.title: Cisco Secure Access - [Completed Emergency Maintenance] US (Virginia) - From 2026-07-30 18:34 UTC to 2026-07-30 19:21 UTC Notification [resolved]
item.description: This emergency maintenance activity was completed on July 30, 2026. We are publishing this notice retrospectively to provide customers with a complete record of the activity. The activity addressed a known issue with the existing load balancer and involved removing the affected load-balancing component to restore service stability. Date and Time July 30, 2026, from 18:34 UTC to 19:21 UTC. Impact During the maintenance window, customers using the affected Secure Web Gateway data center may have experienced intermittent issues reaching internet destinations. item.description:

Cisco Secure Access customers with policies configured to block the "M365 Copilot" or "Microsoft Copilot" application categories should no longer experience related access issues with Microsoft 365 services.
Customers who applied the previously provided workaround can review and restore their policy settings as appropriate for their organization’s security requirements.
Thank you for your patience. If you continue to experience issues, please contact Cisco Customer Support.
